# Remove Codecs

This mod removes all codec subfolders from Plex's /config/Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server/Codecs/ folder, preserves the .device-id, and allows Plex to repopulate the codecs folder while starting up.

Add it to the `plex` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:plex-remove-codecs
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:plex-remove-codecs|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/plex-remove-codecs/
